items.text: haan ji
kal transfer
theek hai

items.context: Have you already made the payment?
items.text: already done

items.context: When did you make the payment?
items.text: kal raat ko

items.context: Did the amount get credited to your account?
items.text: paise aa gaye
haan mein paise kal hi transfer kar diya tha
thoda ruk jao woh transfer ka proof dikhata hu
matlab transaction failed nahi hua tha basically
haan ji maine bank se confirmation bhi le liya hai
woh transfer hua tha last week Tuesday nahi sorry Wednesday
sir mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua
payment kar diya tha par confirmation message nahi mila mujhe

items.context: Can you confirm when you did the transfer?
items.text: haan maine kal online banking se transfer kiya tha

items.context: Please tell me the exact date of payment.
items.text: sorry Monday nahi Thursday ko payment hua tha

items.context: Did you get any message about the transfer success?
items.text: matlab transfer hua tha successful but amount reflect nahi hua

items.context: Is the amount deducted from your bank account?
items.text: haan ji payable amount already bank se cut ho chuki hai

items.context: Can you send us the transaction receipt for verification?
items.text: transfer receipt ke saath mein turant bhejta hu aapko
haan ji payment mein last Saturday ne ki thi aur mere bank statement mein dikh bhi raha hai
woh paise mera account se definitely kat gaye hain par aapke end pe show nahi ho raha hai abhi tak
main aapko receipt bhej dunga whatsapp pe theek hai thoda time dijiyega please confirm kardo
mainne apne side se transfer kiya tha par lagta hai reference number galat pad gaya hoga shayad
paise transfer kar diya tha 26 February ki date ko aap log confirm karke bata dijiye please
abhi thoda confusion hai mera receipt bhi mere paas hai aur bank statement bhi match kar raha hai
haan matlab main apne net banking se payment kar chuka hu please aap verify karke bata dijiye

items.context: Are you sure the payment didn't go through from your side?
items.text: haan mere account se paise deduct ho gaye hain lekin aapke system mein reflect nahi kar raha hai

items.context: Can you tell me the payment date and provide proof?
items.text: meinne 10 March ko payment ki thi, receipt bhi mere paas hai, pehle verify kar dijiyega

items.context: Have you checked if the payment appears in our system?
items.text: matlab sab kuch theek tha lekin aapke database mein abhi tak meri payment reflect nahi kar rahi hai

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: already_paid - says they have already paid and gives details
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, matlab, woh, accha, haan ji); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, nahi, Wednesday')

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
